lines: Amane
「Kotarou?!!」
Amane looked at Kotarou's wound.
He was collapsed on the ground, holding his stomach and groaning in pain.
The bleeding was heavy. But it was not from a vital point.
Bantetsu
「Hyo hyo. I'm not going to kill him. That's Danjou's little boy, is it not? In that case, I have any number of uses for him.」
Bantetsu
「I just put him to sleep for a little while, so that he can't run away.」
Amane
「Lowlife!! Don't you utter Danjou-sama's name with your rotten mouth......!」
Bantetsu
「Hyo? You, as well, are the same as ever. Your thinking is antiquated, for one so young――」
Bantetsu
「There is no point whatsoever in showing respect for a dead man now, I would say.」
Bantetsu
「I have fulfilled my obligation to the head of the clan, just in going along with that ill-advised campaign.」
Amane
While administering the best first-aid she could to Kotarou―wrapping his coat around him to stop the bleeding—she scowled at the old man.
That was right.
This was the kind of sleazebag this man was.
Kotarou
「Amane-san...... Who is he......?」
Kotarou, who had had his abdomen skewered, murmured weakly.
Amane
「He is Tekkain Bantetsu――leader of the Fuuma Rogue Ninja Faction that broke away from Gosha.」
Amane
「Formerly a leading member of the Nisha family and Danjou-sama's close aide. User of an Evil Eye that transforms metal at will.
Kotarou
「Evil Eye......」
Amane's former “comrade”, who had continued to fight even after the Fuuma rebellion ended.
But now, things were different.
Amane
「I left the Rogue Ninja Faction because of his apostasy......」
Bantetsu had forgotten his ideals of Fuuma restoration, and begun to operate the Rogue Ninja Faction as his own private army.
He had moved to not only ally with the UFS, but with some kind of power within the government――
That was something which clearly ran counter to Danjou's ideals, which advocated independence from the Taimanin government.
Bantetsu
「Hmm? That must be some kind of misunderstanding. I am a kindly old man, as you can see.」
Amane
「What's kindly about you, heretic?!! How many of our comrades have you killed with your own hands?!!」
It was Bantetsu's nature to be cruel and unfeeling.
Many of those among the rogue ninja who disobeyed him had been purged as examples.
Kotarou
「A-Amane-san......」
At that point, Kotarou's breathing became ragged.
He coughed weakly, grasped Amane's hand, and tried to whisper something――
Amane
But that barely formed into words before the boy's eyes fell shut.
Bantetsu

「Hyo hyo. I may have avoided his vitals, but it is not a light wound, after all.
――Now, butler of Danjou.」
Bantetsu quietly stepped towards the two of them, saying, “It would seem that neither of us shall have time to enjoy this at our leisure.”
Bantetsu
「To be honest, this kid's life has far more value than that of riff-raff like you.」
Bantetsu
「――Hand him over, Amane. If you do, I shall spare your life.」
Amane
「Hmph, that's out of the question, you old monster......」
Making a daring smile, she blocked the way in front of him.
She cared nothing for the likes of her own life.
Because fortuitously, she had once again been able to encounter something greater than it.
Amane
「Do you think I want to ever lose a “master” again?!」
Amane
「I, Fuuma Amane, will put everything on the line to protect him!!」
